title: HOLDOUT — surveyor says rising damp; damp is under a radiator valve with a wet valve tail
why: Holdout twin of GOLDEN-A-005/A-009: a clearly wrong hypothesis against an observed plumbing defect. Do not read while tuning prompts.

room.name: Living Room
room.note: Damp patch to wall and skirting directly under the radiator valve, about 300mm wide. Valve tail is wet to the touch, drip forming. 55% at skirting under valve, 14% at skirting 1m along. Ground floor.

transcripts: Living room, damp under the radiator, three hundred wide, skirting's damp. Valve tail is wet, there's a drip forming. Fifty five under the valve, fourteen a metre along. Ground floor so I'll say rising damp.

must_not_happen.label: no agreement with rising damp against an observed wet valve
rising damp is not the preferred cause
